compress_bytes: compress bytes data losslessly using the PNG format by reshaping into a grayscale image
decompress_png_data: decompress PNG-encoded bytes back to the original byte sequence
get_closest_factors: get the two closest integer factors of a given integer
compress_and_decompress_roundtrip: compress bytes with PNG and decompress to verify the original data is recovered
compress_binary_data: compress arbitrary binary data into a lossless PNG-compressed byte stream
